solutions.title: Linear scan
solutions.strategy: Scan each value until the target is found or the array is exhausted.

timeComplexity.explanation: Every value may be inspected once.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only the loop state is stored.

solutions.title: Duplicate-aware binary search
solutions.strategy: Use rotated binary search when one side is known sorted, and shrink both ends when duplicates make the order ambiguous.

timeComplexity.explanation: The duplicate-shrinking fallback can remove only one value per step in the worst case; otherwise it behaves like O(log n).

spaceComplexity.explanation: The search keeps only three indices.
